Phase 57-08 follow-up: baseline is now 831 KB (measured). The previous 792/565 values were measured with the worker shell in a lazy chunk the gate could not see; this 831 entry is the first measurement of the worker's actual first download on /. Like-for-like, the retired /sops list page measured 795 KB after the 57-04 gate fix and the 57-06 header deletion, so the one screen costs +36 KB (stage, rooms, frame, Now card). Decision by the phase-57 orchestrator on 2026-10-05; WorkerShell is a static import again, AdminShell stays the lazy seam.

Phase 58-11: tabbed page replaced by the focus frame (server-resolved page + FocusWalker); measured 794 KB, moved DOWN by hand from 795. The gate sums shared chunks only: the route's own page chunk (about 37 KB raw, URL-encoded path) is the known uncounted blind spot, so the old tabs leaving and the walk arriving are both invisible to this number.

Phase 58-16: block machinery, source viewer and old walkthrough/tab leftovers deleted; measured 792 KB, moved DOWN by hand from 794. Never up. The gate's forbidden-marker self-validation was re-derived in the same commit: the client source viewer carried the pdfjs-dist specifier and the mammoth literals, so the scan now also reads .next/server/chunks and the parse route bundle, and the pdfjs marker is 'pdf.worker' instead of the package name. The marker groups themselves are unchanged.

Phase 59-12 (orchestrator decision, not the executor): OfficePane mounted lazily from both shells; measured 834 KB against 831 (+3, tolerance 2). Diff of the summed file list against the parent commit: webpack runtime +1.4 KB because SignOffPanel imports the lightbox stylesheet and, once the pane is in the module graph, that becomes an async CSS chunk and pulls the mini-css loader into the shared runtime; react-query shared chunks +0.33 KB; page chunk +0.28 KB. The pane itself is in its own chunk (1362.*.js), not charged to /. Alternatives rejected: route-level lightbox CSS (every worker downloads ~1.9 KB they never use); a lazy seam for the worker room bodies (~0.1 KB). Moved UP by hand from 831 to 834 as the accepted one-time runtime cost of the first lazy CSS chunk; the next lazy stylesheet costs nothing extra.

Phase 60-16 (orchestrator decision, not the executor): measured 795 KB against 792 (+3, tolerance 2). Summed-file diff against the parent build: only the webpack runtime chunk grew, ~95 bytes, from the additional lazy chunks this phase adds (composer, ask picker, objective editor/line, bell, overview); the raw total went 794.44 -> 794.53 KB and crossed a rounding edge. Fallbacks tried: lazy ObjectiveLine in BrowseDocument (no change, reverted), bell behind next/dynamic (needed for /, kept), one lazy chunk merged (-23 B). Moved UP by hand from 792 to 795 as the accepted runtime cost of the phase's lazy seams; the route's own page chunk is unchanged.
